svg.title: MOD-17473 · Native OSS cluster · full-result performance
svg.desc: Paired throughput and p50/p95/p99 latency effects for equal-row-work cluster replies, faceted by per-primary SEARCH_THREADS.
svg.text: MOD-17473 · Native OSS cluster · full-result performance
Geomean of per-pair PR/baseline ratios, shown as (PR/baseline − 1) × 100%; equal 10k-row work and complete-reply hiredis timing.
Per case: 10 baseline/PR pairs = 20 fresh two-primary topology observations = 40 Redis process executions.
This figure: 120 pairs / 240 topology observations / 480 Redis processes. Whole campaign: 180 pairs / 360 topology observations / 720 Redis processes.
paired effect + 95% order-stratified whole-pair bootstrap CI
SEARCH_THREADS=1 per primary · n=10 pairs/row (5 AB, 5 BA)

Public requests are coordinator-async/blocked in every case; W0 is shard-inline and W1/W4 are shard-deferred.
CIs: 10,000 order-stratified whole-pair resamples, seed 17473; resamples are not benchmark runs.
